correctness.rationale: Verified every inference line-by-line. Rank-5 paving => all sets size <=4 independent, so any 3-set C has r(C)=3 and any 5-set has rank 4 iff dependent (in H) else 5. Contraction rank formula gives M/C rank 2, loopless (r({x})=4-3=1), and r({x,y})=1 iff C+{x,y} in H else 2, so parallel pairs correspond exactly to H-membership. If x adjacent to y1!=y2 in G_C then H1=C+{x,y1}, H2=C+{x,y2} are distinct members of H intersecting in >=C+{x} (size>=4), contradicting Johnson-stability (|intersection|<=3). Hence G_C is matching+isolates (max degree <=1). Matching on N=n-3 vertices has alpha>=ceil(N/2); for n>=12, N>=9 so alpha>=5. Any independent 5-set I has all 10 pairs outside H (bases), plus looplessness => (M/C)|I is simple rank-2 on 5 points with all pairs bases, i.e. U_{2,5}, obtained as contract C + delete E\(C cup I), a valid minor. Covers empty-H case (U_{5,n} contains U_{2,5}). Bound n>=12 sharp for this argument (N>=9 iff n>=12). Sparse/dual, cyclic, connectivity, counting hypotheses correctly noted as unneeded (paving suffices). Corollary correctly applies to target tail (all large primes ==1 mod 20 exceed 12). Computational companion is honestly labeled illustration, not proof; replayed independently: python3 verify_disproof.py exits 0, OK at n=17 (680 triples) and n=41 (10660 triples), Johnson-stable orbit of (0,1,2,4,9), every G_C matching with explicit witness.

value.rationale: General impossibility theorem, not a narrow datum: for all rank-5 paving matroids with Johnson-stable nonbases at n>=12, U_{2,5} minor unavoidable. Directly resolves the admitted valuable target (infinite cyclic U_{2,5}-free sparse-paving density family on Geelen/Pendavingh-van der Pol benchmark) by proving its core conjunction inconsistent, preventing wasted constructive search and giving a reusable obstruction for any future Ex(U_{2,5}) paving search. Sharp threshold, honestly limited (n<=11, non-paving, non-stable left open), unconditional proof (computation only illustration). Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.

decisive_checks.broader_coverage: Searched dominance query: U_{2,5}-free paving classification, growth excluding uniform minor, sparse-paving Ex(U_{2,k}) smallness, cover-complexity caps. Found: Pendavingh-van der Pol counting smallness, Geelen open problems, van der Pol ubiquity, Oxley excluded-minor theory. Why no coverage: all are asymptotic upper regimes or general structure; none proves that every Johnson-stable rank-5 paving matroid at n>=12 contains U_{2,5}, and the density cap n^2 vs C(n,5) is sparse so no contradiction implies the obstruction. Target impossibility is a finite exact forcing lemma, not a special case of an asymptotic bound.
decisive_checks.claim_vs_prior_implication: Compared theorem hypotheses/conclusions literally against nearest priors. Prior Johnson lemmas state nonbases of sparse paving form stable set (converse direction) and local row/column structure; they do not derive a U_{2,5} minor from stability. No prior's result substantively implies alpha(G_C)>=5 => U_{2,5} restriction. The disproof's contraction+matching+independence argument is absent from snippets, metadata, and fetched Pendavingh-van der Pol full text. Hence no recomputation, certificate, corollary, or repackaging of a known stronger fact.
decisive_checks.equivalent_formulations: Searched literal statement (rank-5 paving Johnson-stable nonbases U_{2,5} contraction matching) plus synonymous encodings: 5-point line / long line / line length, stable set in J(E,5) / J(n,5), circuit-hyperplane intersection <=3, 4-(n,5,1) packing, Steiner system S(3,5,n), complement/dual/paving vs sparse-paving, incidence/circulant encodings. Found only generic Johnson/stable-set correspondence (Lemma: nonbases <-> stable set) and packing language in unrelated contexts. No source states the matching lemma or n>=12 forcing under any synonym; title/embedding similarity (e.g. sparse-paving counting papers) does not equal coverage.
